item.title: Le Male Elixir by Jean Paul Gaultier – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Jean Paul Gaultier
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Le Male Elixir by Jean Paul Gaultier is a rich, honeyed take on the barbershop icon: cool lavender and mint up top, melting into warm vanilla and benzoin, then a sweet base of honey, tonka bean and tobacco. It is a Parfum concentration created by Quentin Bisch, and one of the most complimented sweet scents for men. Hand-decanted from the original bottle into a 1ml sample, 2ml, 5ml or 10ml travel spray.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Mint
Middle: Vanilla, Benzoin
Base: Honey, Tonka Bean, Tobacco

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: evening · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

item.description:

Overview

Banadir 116 by Banadir Fragrance is a crisp, green vetiver scent that opens on bergamot sparkle with a tingle of pink and Sichuan pepper, then moves into a fresh heart of blackcurrant bud, geranium and rose. It is an Extrait de Parfum, giving a bright, airy profile more body and staying power. Banadir 116 is a clean, refined everyday vetiver inspired by Creed Wild Vetiver.

The dry-down is dry and polished, with vetiver, cedarwood and amberwood leaving a smooth, earthy-woody finish.

Top: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Sichuan Pepper
Middle: Blackcurrant Bud, Geranium, Rose
Base: Amberwood, Vetiver, Cedarwood

Banadir 114 by Banadir Fragrance is a bright, juicy fruity-woody chypre that opens on sparkling pineapple, bergamot and black pepper, then moves into a jasmine, patchouli and cedar heart.
